summary: Comprehensive architectural explanation and revised implementation plan addressing all four user questions: (1) Stage 5B timeline for adding Neon DATABASE_URL, (2) Admin Dashboard enhancements within the dedicated Database tab, (3) Safe database configuration policy vs. UI security constraints, and (4) Definitive roles of Neon PostgreSQL (authoritative for courses, high-frequency progress, quizzes, and queues) vs. Firestore/Firebase (authoritative for Auth, real-time presence, and historical ledger audit).
